type_properties.instance_lifetime: PyType_GenericNew + tp_dealloc; every sealed C allocation freed in StageAOwner_dealloc via seal_owner_free_contents

custody_model.seal_flag: int sealed; 0 before admission, 1 after; re-__init__ raises SourceRelationIntegrityError('...one-shot...')
custody_model.no_python_visible_mutable_handle: identity material lives only in C-owned char* copies; no capsule, no exposed dict, no loader
custody_model.two_phase_admission: identity copies for ALL members are taken first; __init__ failure leaves self unsealed and yields no partially sealed owner

admission_guards.requires_exact_list_or_tuple: PyList_Check / PyTuple_Check; generators, sets, mappings and duck-typed iterables refused so no hostile __iter__/__len__/__getattribute__ drives admission
admission_guards.relation_field_types_checked: ref.key and content_hash must be str
admission_guards.reentrant_owner_input_rejected: an already-sealed owner presented as input is refused by the one-shot check

resolve_exact_interface.no_inference: no label / ID / latest / default matching; miss raises SourceRelationIntegrityError('...no label/ID/latest/default inference')
resolve_exact_interface.normalisation: all shapes folded to the single canonical key string kind|object_id|content_hash
resolve_exact_interface.returns: a NEW reference to the admitted relation object
resolve_exact_interface.identity_reverification: on every lookup the live object's ref.key AND content_hash are re-read and compared against the sealed C copies; any post-seal substitute, ref swap or hash mutation raises

native_error_types.StageAExactKeyError: raised when the argument is not an exact ref or ref mapping

non_authorizing_surface.no_positive_authority_symbol: module and type expose no AUTHORIZED, RelationDecision, authorize or issue symbol

tcb_seam.trusted_semantic_hash: module-level canonical hash supplied by the embedding application at construction; stored natively, never replaceable from Python at resolve time
tcb_seam.by_key_index_key: Stage A derives the index key natively from the already-validated exact ref key, deliberately avoiding any Python callback in the admission path; Stage B MUST replace this with true relation object key material

custody_hash_caveat: the exposed custody_hash is a deterministic native FNV-1a walk over sealed keys and is PROVENANCE ONLY. It is explicitly NOT the accepted P07 custody hash and must not be presented as one.
